title: Competitor listing monitoring and price position: competitor listings captured in CIP, external scraper feed ingest, suggested matches (spec section 9.9)
acceptance_criteria: Warren 2026-10-07: CIP must make a side competitor-price scraper unnecessary
Competitor product pages are registered and polled by the same capture scheduler as our listings, with polite per-marketplace limits
An ingest endpoint and file template accept an external scraper's competitor price points into fact_competitor_price, keyed to approved our-SKU to competitor-SKU matches
Suggested competitor matches are offered for steward approval; nothing auto-approves
Competition screen and the promotion line show the latest competitor price and our price position; empty means no rows, not zero
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
